description_en: Calls the DescribeAlertLogCount operation to query alert history statistics
description_zh: 调用DescribeAlertLogCount接口统计报警历史
name: DescribeAlertLogCount

parameters.help_en:
The start timestamp for querying alert history.

Unit: milliseconds.

You can query only the alert history within the last year. If the query time range exceeds one year, the `AlertLogCount` response parameter is empty.

The interval between the start time (StartTime) and end time (EndTime) must be less than or equal to 15 days. Both parameters must be specified or left empty at the same time. If neither is specified, the alert history of the last 15 minutes is queried by default
parameters.help_zh:
查询报警历史的开始时间戳。

单位：毫秒。

您只能查询最近一年的报警历史，如果查询时间大于一年，则参数`AlertLogCount`的返回值为空。

开始时间（StartTime）和结束时间（EndTime）之间必须小于等于15天，并且需要同时填写或同时不填写。如果不填，则默认查询最近15分钟的报警历史
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end timestamp for querying alert history.

Unit: milliseconds.

You can query only the alert history within the last year. If the query time range exceeds one year, the `AlertLogCount` response parameter is empty.

The interval between the start time (StartTime) and end time (EndTime) must be less than or equal to 15 days. Both parameters must be specified or left empty at the same time. If neither is specified, the alert history of the last 15 minutes is queried by default
parameters.help_zh:
查询报警历史的结束时间戳。

单位：毫秒。

您只能查询最近一年的报警历史，如果查询时间大于一年，则参数`AlertLogCount`的返回值为空。

开始时间（StartTime）和结束时间（EndTime）之间必须小于等于15天，并且需要同时填写或同时不填写。如果不填，则默认查询最近15分钟的报警历史
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The alert level and notification method. Valid values:

<props="china">- P2: Phone call + text message + email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>

<props="china">- P3: Text message + email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>

<props="china">- P4: Email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>

<props="china">- OK: No alert.</props>

<props="intl">- P4: Email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>

<props="intl">- OK: No alert.</props>

<props="partner">- P4: Email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>

<props="partner">- OK: No alert.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
报警的级别和通知方式。取值：

<props="china">- P2：电话+短信+邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="china">- P3：短信+邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="china">- P4：邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="china">- OK：无报警。</props>

<props="intl">- P4：邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="intl">- OK：无报警。</props>

<props="partner">- P4：邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="partner">- OK：无报警。</props>
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en:
The alert status. Valid values:
0: An alert is triggered or the alert recovers to Normal.
1: The alert rule is not effective.
2: The mute period.
3: The host is restarting.
4: Alerts are not send.

<props="china">When the alert status is 0, if the value of Level is P2, P3, or P4, an alert is triggered. If the value of Level is OK, the alert recovers to Normal.</props>
<props="intl">When the alert status is 0, if the value of Level is P4, an alert is triggered. If the value of Level is OK, the alert recovers to Normal.</props>
<props="partner">When the alert status is 0, if the value of Level is P4, an alert is triggered. If the value of Level is OK, the alert recovers to Normal.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
报警状态。取值：
0：发生报警或报警恢复正常。
1：非生效期。
2：通道沉默周期。
3：主机重启中。
4：不发送报警。

<props="china">当报警状态为0时，如果Level的取值为P2、P3或P4，则发生告警；如果Level的取值为OK，则报警恢复正常。</props>
<props="intl">当报警状态为0时，如果Level的取值为P4，则发生告警；如果Level的取值为OK，则报警恢复正常。</props>
<props="partner">当报警状态为0时，如果Level的取值为P4，则发生告警；如果Level的取值为OK，则报警恢复正常。</props>

`groupId`: aggregates by application group.
`contactGroup`: aggregates by alert contact group.
`product,metricName`: aggregates by Alibaba Cloud service and metric
